newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: A bullish trend in foreign bond markets and good results at the Treasury bond auction put fuel to an already roaring Spanish debt market which ended sharply higher on Tuesday, dealers said.
The 10-year cash spread fell to around 95 basis points from 100 earlier, long futures broke resistance at 114.55, and dealers were looking at the possibility of a new record.

"All domestic factors hint at a solid market here, so as foreign markets permit it, bonos show new gains," a Madrid-based dealer said. He said the five- and 15-year auction on Wednesday was not worrying: "The biggest part was allotted today."
